views.name: patient_core_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS id,
  Patient.SEX AS sex,
  Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
  Patient."First Date" AS first_date,
  Patient.Admission AS admission,
  Patient.Diagnosis AS diagnosis
FROM Patient
views.description: One-row-per-patient demographic and admission baseline attributes for cohort selection and grouping (keeps canonical id and common dimensions used for filtering/grouping).

views.name: patient_admission_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  id,
  CASE
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(sex)) = 'M' THEN 'M'
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(sex)) = 'F' THEN 'F'
    WHEN TRIM(UPPER(sex)) = '' OR sex IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE SUBSTR(TRIM(UPPER(sex)),1,1)
  END AS sex_norm,
  CASE
    WHEN admission IS NULL THEN 'UNKNOWN'
    WHEN TRIM(admission) IN ('+', 'Y', 'YES', 'ADMITTED', 'IN') THEN 'ADMITTED'
    WHEN TRIM(admission) IN ('-', 'N', 'NO', 'OUT', 'NOT ADMITTED') THEN 'NOT ADMITTED'
    ELSE TRIM(admission)
  END AS admission_norm
FROM patient_core_demographics
views.description: Normalized patient-level admission status and canonical sex value. Canonicalizes admission to explicit labels and normalizes sex values to uppercase single-letter codes; exposes id and normalized fields for aggregations.

views.name: patient_counts_by_admission
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  pac.id AS id,
  pac.sex_norm AS sex_norm,
  pac.admission_norm AS admission_norm,
  COUNT(DISTINCT pac.id) AS patient_count
FROM patient_admission_cohort AS pac
GROUP BY
  pac.sex_norm,
  pac.admission_norm
views.description: Pre-aggregated counts of patients by normalized admission label and sex; useful for quick population comparisons. Keeps sex and admission as grouping keys and raw patient_count measure. Does not bake any question-specific literal filters.

views.name: patient_basic_demographics
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  Patient.SEX AS SEX,
  Patient.Birthday AS Birthday,
  CASE
    WHEN Patient.Birthday IS NULL OR trim(Patient.Birthday) = '' THEN NULL
    WHEN length(Patient.Birthday) >= 4 THEN CAST(substr(Patient.Birthday,1,4) AS INTEGER)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS birth_year
FROM Patient
views.description: One row per patient with canonicalized demographic fields (sex and birthday broken out into year). Keeps raw birthday and extracts birth year for easy filtering and grouping.

views.name: female_patient_cohort
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Patient.ID AS ID,
  Patient.Birthday AS Birthday,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS birth_year
FROM Patient
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
views.description: Cohort of patients filtered to sex = 'F'. Useful as a starting set for female-specific rates and aggregates. Exposes ID and birthday/year for further filtering.

views.name: patient_counts_by_sex_and_birth_year_bucket
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  p."SEX" AS SEX,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") AS INTEGER) AS birth_year,
  COUNT(p."ID") AS patient_count
FROM "Patient" p
WHERE p."Birthday" IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p."SEX", CAST(strftime('%Y', p."Birthday") AS INTEGER)
views.description: Aggregated counts of patients grouped by sex and birth_year. Useful to compute percentages and trends by cohort. Does not apply question-specific year thresholds.

views.name: patient_examination_with_age

  Examination."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
  Patient.Birthday AS birthday,
  CAST(strftime('%Y', Examination."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)

FROM Examination
JOIN Patient ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID

views.name: patient_monthly_lab_rollup
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  Laboratory.ID AS id,
  substr(Laboratory.Date,1,7) AS year_month,
  SUM("T-CHO") AS tcho_sum,
  COUNT("T-CHO") AS tcho_count,
  SUM(
    COALESCE(GOT,0)
    + COALESCE(GPT,0)
    + COALESCE(LDH,0)
    + COALESCE(ALP,0)
    + COALESCE(TP,0)
    + COALESCE(ALB,0)
    + COALESCE(UA,0)
    + COALESCE(UN,0)
    + COALESCE(CRE,0)
    + COALESCE("T-BIL",0)
    + COALESCE(TG,0)
    + COALESCE(CPK,0)
    + COALESCE(GLU,0)
    + COALESCE(WBC,0)
    + COALESCE(RBC,0)
    + COALESCE(HGB,0)
    + COALESCE(HCT,0)
    + COALESCE(PLT,0)
    + COALESCE(PT,0)
    + COALESCE(APTT,0)
    + COALESCE(FG,0)
    + COALESCE(PIC,0)
    + COALESCE(TAT,0)
    + COALESCE(TAT2,0)
  ) AS other_measures_sum_placeholder
FROM Laboratory
WHERE Laboratory.ID IS NOT NULL
  AND Laboratory.Date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY Laboratory.ID, substr(Laboratory.Date,1,7)
views.description: Aggregated lab measures per patient per year-month (YYYY-MM). Useful for month-by-month comparisons and percent-change calculations.

  "Diagnosis" AS Diagnosis

Exposes patient id, exam date, antibody measurements, ANA pattern, thrombosis flag, and diagnosis for downstream filtering and aggregation.

views.name: laboratory_results_81
views.body_sql:
SELECT
  ID AS id,
  Date AS date,
  -- ensure numeric TG
  CASE
    WHEN TG IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof(TG) IN ('integer','real') THEN TG
    WHEN trim(TG) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(TG AS REAL)
  END AS tg,
  CASE
    WHEN GLU IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof(GLU) IN ('integer','real') THEN GLU
    WHEN trim(GLU) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(GLU AS REAL)
  END AS glucose,
  CASE
    WHEN "T-CHO" IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof("T-CHO") IN ('integer','real') THEN "T-CHO"
    WHEN trim("T-CHO") = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST("T-CHO" AS REAL)
  END AS cholesterol,
  CASE
    WHEN WBC IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof(WBC) IN ('integer','real') THEN WBC
    WHEN trim(WBC) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(WBC AS REAL)
  END AS wbc,
  CASE
    WHEN RBC IS NULL THEN NULL
    WHEN typeof(RBC) IN ('integer','real') THEN RBC
    WHEN trim(RBC) = '' THEN NULL
    ELSE CAST(RBC AS REAL)
  END AS rbc
FROM Laboratory
WHERE TG IS NOT NULL
views.description: Laboratory measurement rows normalized for numeric interpretation. One row per lab measurement (patient id + date) exposing key lab analytes (TG and other lipids) and ensuring numeric types where possible.
